blurb:
Start point: the Samuel de Champlain Monument, next to Dufferin Terrace - open the app and hit "Start."

Briefing in-app: your case file, suspects & how gameplay works (2-3 mins).

Chapters: 10-14 bite-size missions guiding you through Old Quebec highlights.

Gameplay: decode ciphers, match details on buildings, choose story paths.

Pacing: typical playtime ~90-120 minutes with optional cafe breaks.

Finish: back at the Samuel de Champlain Monument; get your team score & debrief screen.

Difficulty: Beginner to intermediate. Walking: ~2-3 km on old town streets and a few staircases.

Who it's for: Couples, friends, families with older kids, team bonding.
